# Button

Buttons carry the action hierarchy: one crimson primary per context, matte-black secondary for strong but non-critical actions, and ghost for everything else.

`PhantomPortals.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<PhantomPortals.Button />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PhantomPortals.Button"></x-import>
```

## Notes

One crimson primary per context; matte-black secondary; ghost for the rest.

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost'` |  |
| `size` | `'md' \| 'lg'` |  |
| `icon` | `IconName` |  |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  |
| `href` | `string` | Render as a link instead of a button. |
| `type` | `'button' \| 'submit' \| 'reset'` |  |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'type'>._
